notes: Baseline retains original typed incoming query; code held constant across schema phases.
Batch copies exclude parsing, source archival, semantic validation and publication.

No scan settings were forced. Raw reports are reproducible with the documented module command.
Separate fixed-reader probe overlapped load; only its plan topology and result equality are compared.

separate_fixed_reader_probe.sql: SELECT r.entity_id FROM public.ucm_relations r WHERE r.snapshot_id=$1 AND r.entity_id IN (SELECT entity_id FROM public.ucm_relations WHERE snapshot_id=$1 AND target_id=$2 UNION ALL SELECT relation_id FROM public.ucm_relation_candidates WHERE snapshot_id=$1 AND candidate_id=$2) AND (cardinality($3::text[])=0 OR r.relation_kind=ANY($3)) ORDER BY r.entity_id LIMIT $4
